The five baby orangutans were found in the Bichitrapur/Ranakatha forest area and have now been shifted to Nandankanan Zoological Park in Bhubaneswar. summary: A 33-year-old private gardener has died after allegedly suffering an electric shock while pruning trees inside Delhi University’s South Campus.According to Delhi Police, a PCR call about the incident was received at around 5:30 pm on September 7. Police reached the spot and shifted the injured man to Safdarjung Hospital, where doctors declared him brought dead. A medico-legal case was also prepared.Police have registered an FIR under Sections 287 and 106(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, relating to negligent conduct involving electrical apparatus and causing death by negligence. The exact circumstances that led to the electrocution are being investigated.The incident has also triggered protests by DU students and members of the deceased’s family, with allegations of negligence and demands for accountability, compensation and support for the family.
